newsitem.title: USA: PP&L Susquehanna 1 nuke remains off line.
newsitem.headline: PP&L Susquehanna 1 nuke remains off line.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power and Light's 1,090 megawatt (MW) Susquehanna 1 nuclear unit was still off line early Wednesday due to a valve problem, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was in hot standby "due to a problem with bypass valves," the NRC plant status report stated.
A restart date of March 6 was given, but the company was not immediately available to confirm.
The unit, in Berwick, Pa., was manually shut Feb 25 in anticipation of a loss of vacuum in the unit's main condenser, which removes heat from steam leaving the unit's main turbine.
The adjacent unit 2, with a generating capacity of 1,094 MW, is scheduled to shut down March 15 for refueling.
